config.content:
## Waggle SRE dashboard
Read top to bottom: **1. RED** for every request into the PetAdoptions services and the Waggle agents, **2. USE** for the ECS and EKS capacity they run on, **3. AI agents** for volume, errors, latency and tokens per agent.

config.queryString: SELECT count(*) AS requests FROM traces.default WHERE kind = 'SERVER' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] NOT LIKE '%canary' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] NOT LIKE 'traffic-generator%' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] <> 'rds-seeder'

SELECT sum(CASE WHEN upper(TRY_CAST(status['code'] AS VARCHAR)) IN ('2', 'ERROR', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN upper(TRY_CAST(status['code'] AS VARCHAR)) IN ('2', 'ERROR', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*), 2) AS error_rate_pct FROM traces.default WHERE kind = 'SERVER' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] NOT LIKE '%canary' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] NOT LIKE 'traffic-generator%' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] <> 'rds-seeder'

SELECT round(approx_percentile_cont(CAST(durationNano AS DOUBLE) / 1e6, 0.5), 0) AS p50_ms, round(approx_percentile_cont(CAST(durationNano AS DOUBLE) / 1e6, 0.9), 0) AS p90_ms FROM traces.default WHERE kind = 'SERVER' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] NOT LIKE '%canary' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] NOT LIKE 'traffic-generator%' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] <> 'rds-seeder' AND durationNano IS NOT NULL

SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', `@timestamp`) AS t, replace(resource['attributes']['service.name'], '.DEFAULT', '') AS service, count(*) AS requests FROM traces.default WHERE kind = 'SERVER' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] NOT LIKE '%canary' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] NOT LIKE 'traffic-generator%' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] <> 'rds-seeder' GROUP BY t, service ORDER BY t

SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', `@timestamp`) AS t, replace(resource['attributes']['service.name'], '.DEFAULT', '') AS service, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN upper(TRY_CAST(status['code'] AS VARCHAR)) IN ('2', 'ERROR', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*), 2) AS error_rate_pct FROM traces.default WHERE kind = 'SERVER' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] NOT LIKE '%canary' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] NOT LIKE 'traffic-generator%' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] <> 'rds-seeder' GROUP BY t, service ORDER BY t

SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', `@timestamp`) AS t, replace(resource['attributes']['service.name'], '.DEFAULT', '') AS service, round(approx_percentile_cont(CAST(durationNano AS DOUBLE) / 1e6, 0.9), 0) AS p90_ms FROM traces.default WHERE kind = 'SERVER' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] NOT LIKE '%canary' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] NOT LIKE 'traffic-generator%' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] <> 'rds-seeder' AND durationNano IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t, service ORDER BY t

SELECT replace(resource['attributes']['service.name'], '.DEFAULT', '') AS service, count(*) AS requests, sum(CASE WHEN upper(TRY_CAST(status['code'] AS VARCHAR)) IN ('2', 'ERROR', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN upper(TRY_CAST(status['code'] AS VARCHAR)) IN ('2', 'ERROR', 'STATUS_CODE_ERROR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / count(*), 2) AS error_rate_pct, round(approx_percentile_cont(CAST(durationNano AS DOUBLE) / 1e6, 0.5), 0) AS p50_ms, round(approx_percentile_cont(CAST(durationNano AS DOUBLE) / 1e6, 0.9), 0) AS p90_ms FROM traces.default WHERE kind = 'SERVER' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] NOT LIKE '%canary' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] NOT LIKE 'traffic-generator%' AND resource['attributes']['service.name'] <> 'rds-seeder' AND durationNano IS NOT NULL GROUP BY service ORDER BY errors DESC, requests DESC

config.title: 2. USE: utilization, saturation, errors (ECS and EKS)

config.queryString: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', `@timestamp`) AS t, ServiceName AS service, round(max(TRY_CAST(TaskCpuUtilization AS DOUBLE)), 1) AS cpu_pct FROM logs.default WHERE `@logGroupName` LIKE '/aws/ecs/containerinsights/%/performance' AND Type = 'Task' GROUP BY t, service ORDER BY t

SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', `@timestamp`) AS t, ServiceName AS service, round(max(TRY_CAST(TaskMemoryUtilization AS DOUBLE)), 1) AS mem_pct FROM logs.default WHERE `@logGroupName` LIKE '/aws/ecs/containerinsights/%/performance' AND Type = 'Task' GROUP BY t, service ORDER BY t

SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', `@timestamp`) AS t, round(max(TRY_CAST(node_cpu_utilization AS DOUBLE)), 1) AS cpu_pct, round(max(TRY_CAST(node_memory_utilization AS DOUBLE)), 1) AS mem_pct FROM logs.default WHERE `@logGroupName` LIKE '/aws/containerinsights/%/performance' AND Type = 'Node' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

SELECT ServiceName AS service, max(TRY_CAST(DesiredTaskCount AS BIGINT)) AS desired, min(TRY_CAST(RunningTaskCount AS BIGINT)) AS min_running, max(TRY_CAST(PendingTaskCount AS BIGINT)) AS max_pending FROM logs.default WHERE `@logGroupName` LIKE '/aws/ecs/containerinsights/%/performance' AND Type = 'Service' GROUP BY service ORDER BY service

SELECT max(TRY_CAST(cluster_node_count AS BIGINT)) AS nodes, max(TRY_CAST(cluster_failed_node_count AS BIGINT)) AS failed_nodes, max(TRY_CAST(cluster_number_of_running_pods AS BIGINT)) AS running_pods FROM logs.default WHERE `@logGroupName` LIKE '/aws/containerinsights/%/performance' AND Type = 'Cluster'

SELECT PodName AS pod, max(TRY_CAST(pod_number_of_container_restarts AS BIGINT)) AS restarts, round(max(TRY_CAST(pod_cpu_utilization_over_pod_limit AS DOUBLE)), 1) AS cpu_pct_of_limit FROM logs.default WHERE `@logGroupName` LIKE '/aws/containerinsights/%/performance' AND Type = 'Pod' AND Namespace NOT IN ('kube-system', 'amazon-cloudwatch') GROUP BY pod ORDER BY restarts DESC LIMIT 10

config.title: 3. AI agents (Waggle on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore)

config.queryString: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', `@timestamp`) AS t, replace(resource['attributes']['service.name'], '.DEFAULT', '') AS agent, sum(TRY_CAST(attributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'] AS BIGINT) + TRY_CAST(attributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens'] AS BIGINT)) AS tokens FROM traces.default WHERE resource['attributes']['service.name'] LIKE 'WaggleAI%' AND attributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'chat' GROUP BY t, agent ORDER BY t

config.title: 4. Agent quality: did the customer get what they asked for?

panels.title: Catalog tool: calls vs empty results (5 min)

config.queryString: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', `@timestamp`) AS t, count(*) AS catalog_calls, sum(CASE WHEN contains(attributes['gen_ai.tool.call.result'], '"total_count": 0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS empty_results FROM traces.default WHERE attributes['gen_ai.tool.name'] = 'get_available_foods' AND attributes['gen_ai.operation.name'] = 'execute_tool' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', `@timestamp`) AS t, sum(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(attributes['gen_ai.evaluation.score.value'] AS DOUBLE) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recommends_product, sum(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST(attributes['gen_ai.evaluation.score.value'] AS DOUBLE) < 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_catalog_product FROM logs.default WHERE attributes['gen_ai.evaluation.name'] = 'RecommendsCatalogProduct' GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
